description: Chris Spargo's videos are short, documentary-style investigations into the "small questions" and overlooked quirks of British daily life, infrastructure, and history. He typically explores the hidden reasons behind mundane things, like why supermarket car parks have clock towers, bizarre parking apps, or specific road signs, often while filming on location with a deadpan, dryly humorous delivery. The content leans heavily into British-specific curiosities, ranging from the absurdity of "ghost bus routes" to the design of milk caps, aiming to provide a clear, satisfying answer to a niche question in usually under twenty minutes.
